sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/deltacountyparks (Campspot park 3022 'OB Fuller Campground - Bark River, MI'; availability list for 2026-09-15 read in the browser 2026-10-22)

values.note: Delta County (one rate, no resident/non-resident split): basic electric & water $40/night, river/lake view sites $45; rustic forest tent site (no electric) $25. Monthly $900 per 30 days (lakeview sites 18-26 $950 in July and August); 5-month seasonal $2,750 by signed agreement. $5 non-refundable reservation fee for advance bookings; a 4% non-refundable processing fee on card payments (minimum $15 per card use). Campspot showed $45 forest / $45 lake view / $50 lake front for one night in September 2026, the $5 fee included.

fees.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/rates-fees-policies/ ('Basic (Electric &Water ONLY) – $40 per night', 'River/Lake View Sites – $45 per night', 'Rustic Forest Tent Site, no electric – $25', 'Reservation Fee: If a site is booked in advance, a NON-REFUNDABLE $5.00 fee is added', 'A 4% NON-REFUNDABLE processing fee will be added to your total cost'; page footer 2026, 'Draft Campground Policies and Regulations 2026') + Campspot availability 2026-09-15, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/fuller-campground/ ('OB Fuller Campground offers 35 sites with electric (20, 30, 50 AMPS) and water hookups') + https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/rates-fees-policies/ ('Full Hook-up (Electric, Water & SEWER) – $45 per night (Pioneer Trail Park ONLY'; 'Fuller Campground Basic (Electric & Water ONLY Sites)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 35 electric/water sites plus 2 rustic tent sites and 6 rustic cabins. Campspot books 20 RV sites nightly (7 lake front to 65 ft, 8 forest and 4 lake view to 50 ft, 1 rustic); the county also sells monthly and 5-month seasonal stays.

sites.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/fuller-campground/ ('35 sites with electric ... and water hookups'; '6 rustic cabins'; '2 rustic tenting sites') + Campspot availability list (site types 'Lake Front' 7 sites rvLengthMax 65, 'Forest Site' 8 / 50, 'Lake View' 4 / 50, 'Rustic Camping' 1 / 50), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/fuller-campground/ ('Other amenities offered to campers include a dump station, laundry facilities, showers, a sandy beach, and 2 playgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booked online on Campspot ('OB Fuller Reservations'); seasonal sites by phone to the office with a signed agreement. Daily and monthly reservations are paid in full when booked; cancelling costs $15, and within 7 days the whole stay is forfeit.

booking.source: https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/fuller-campground/ ('OB Fuller Reservations' -> https://www.campspot.com/book/deltacountyparks) + https://deltacountymi.gov/parks/rates-fees-policies/ ('Holiday weekends require a 2- day minimum for prior booking'; 'All Daily and Monthly Reservations: MUST BE PAID IN FULL AT THE TIME OF THE RESERVATION'; 'Cancellation Fee: $15.00 CHARGE (per site). In addition, if cancellation is seven (7) days or less prior to your stay, your total reservation cost is forfeited'), read 2026-10-22

note: Delta County park on 82 acres ~15 mi south of Escanaba on M-35, in northern forest where the Bark River meets Lake Michigan; sandy beach, small boat launch, two playgrounds; rustic cabins and tent sites in a hemlock stand. Reservations open Dec 1; season opens in May. --Claude
summary: Delta County park page (403 to curl, read in the browser) + rates page + Campspot: 35 electric/water sites (20/30/50 A), no sewer at Fuller (full hookups are Pioneer Trail Park only), RVs to 65 ft on the lake-front sites; showers, laundry, dump; $40 basic / $45 river-lake view, $5 reservation fee, 4% card fee, no resident split; Campspot booking, 2-night holiday minimum. Fees/hookups/facilities confirmed (now manual); sewer false, count 35, max 65 ft, booking platform/url/min stay added. Season not stated on these pages (left). Phone (906) 786-1020 and website match.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the entry is 'not waterfront', but the county says the park is 'nestled in a northern forest on the shores of Bark River and Lake Michigan' and 'a lakeside camping area', and Campspot sells 7 'Lake Front' and 4 'Lake View' sites (read 2026-10-22).
